title: Oscar and the Ghost
author: Marguerite Pemberton
blurb: Rafael Ravensworth, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
